clue.text: In favour of seeing a friend — for the time being

parts.note: pro means in favour of, as in pros and cons
seeing, as a faculty, is vision
an ally is a friend who sides with you

explanation.surface: Someone backs a plan to visit a friend, but only as a temporary arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done for now, pending a final decision, is done on a temporary basis.

clue.text: Tried in no uncertain way to come to an arrangement

indicators.note: an uncertain way of setting out the letters signals that they are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone attempts hesitantly to reach a deal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uncertain way' rearranges TRIEDINNO; 'to come to an' is padding linking the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A rendition of a song is a particular musical arrangement or performance of it.

clue.text: Five lubricate a point, and that's material

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five
to oil something is to lubricate it
E, east, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: Five people grease a point of machinery, and that matters.
explanation.definitionFit: Voile is a thin, sheer fabric, a type of cloth.

clue.text: People have such rigid notions of the current in large areas of water

indicators.note: the current is placed in the large areas of water, so one word goes inside the other

parts.note: seas are large areas of water
a tide is a current of the sea

explanation.surface: People stubbornly hold fixed views about ocean currents.
explanation.walkthrough: 'People have such' is extra padding leading into the definition 'rigid notions'.
explanation.definitionFit: Fixed, unchangeable opinions are inflexible beliefs.

clue.text: In fashion for all youngsters, so it's said

indicators.note: the answer is held within the words that follow, set in among them

explanation.surface: Some trend is popular with every child, so people say.
explanation.definitionFit: Something conveyed by speech rather than writing is expressed by mouth.

clue.text: A marathon the team's set against

parts.note: a marathon task is a long one
a side is a sports team

explanation.surface: A team is lined up to run a marathon.
explanation.definitionFit: Set against something is placed beside it, next to it for comparison.

clue.text: The language the French can use

parts.note: la is the French for the (feminine)
a tin is a can

explanation.surface: A remark about which words the French may use.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin is the classical tongue of ancient Rome.

clue.text: The trouble taken in making a film?

definitions.text: The trouble taken in making a film?

parts.words: The trouble taken in making a film?
parts.note: trouble taken is effort, and making a film is filming; the phrase also names sudden stabbing aches

explanation.surface: A question about how much effort film production demands.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharp, sudden stabs of discomfort are named as if they were the efforts of filming.

clue.text: A test-drive men organised for publicity

indicators.note: organised means arranged, so the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Some men set up a test drive as a promotional stunt.
explanation.definitionFit: A notice promoting a product is a form of publicity.

clue.text: A girl in theatre make-up

indicators.note: make-up suggests the letters are made up anew, rearranged

explanation.surface: A young actress applying greasepaint at the theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: Henrietta is a female first name.

clue.text: Chose to take no exercise before the middle of the day

parts.note: O, a zero, means nothing or no
PT is physical training, exercise

indicators.note: the central letters are taken from the words that follow, run together

explanation.surface: Someone decided not to work out until midday.
explanation.walkthrough: Run 'the day' together as THEDAY; its middle two letters are ED.
explanation.definitionFit: Opted means made a choice between options.

clue.text: About six an individual may appear sheepish

indicators.note: about means around, so the individual is placed around six

parts.note: an individual is one
VI is the Roman numeral for six

explanation.surface: Around six people may look embarrassed.
explanation.definitionFit: Ovine means of or like sheep.

clue.text: Care of a horse-drawn carriage

definitions.meaning: a public stagecoach, especially in France

explanation.surface: Looking after a carriage pulled by horses.
explanation.definitionFit: Diligence is careful effort, and also the old name for a stagecoach.

clue.text: Popular Italian article about a mineral being harmful

parts.note: in means popular or fashionable

indicators.note: about means around, so the article goes around the mineral

parts.note: il is the Italian masculine article, the
mica is a mineral that splits into thin sheets

explanation.surface: A popular Italian newspaper article about a mineral proving damaging.
explanation.definitionFit: Inimical means hostile or tending to do damage.

clue.text: Concerned with certain lines going the other way

parts.note: in re is legal Latin for concerning, in the matter of
verse is lines of poetry

explanation.surface: Someone worried about poetry lines running backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving backwards is travelling the opposite direction.

clue.text: Most superior if going back home

indicators.note: going back means the little word if is read backwards

parts.note: a nest is a bird's home

explanation.surface: The best place to be is when you return home.
explanation.definitionFit: The finest is the best of all.

clue.text: Running away from work in principle

indicators.note: the work goes in the principle, one word inside the other

parts.note: an element is a basic principle
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Someone flees the job on principle.
explanation.definitionFit: An elopement is running off secretly, usually to marry.

clue.text: A game judge escorted by soldiers' going into church quite unworried

indicators.note: the referee and soldiers go into the church, one piece inside another

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: escorted by means accompanied, so the soldiers follow straight after

parts.note: a ref, referee, judges a game
RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of soldiers

explanation.surface: A referee, with an army escort, enters a church without a care.
explanation.definitionFit: Carefree means free of anxiety, untroubled.

clue.text: Top people given information to examine

parts.note: gen is informal British slang for information
to try a case is to examine it in court

explanation.surface: Leaders are handed facts to study.
explanation.definitionFit: The gentry are the upper classes, the well-born.

clue.text: Extremely hungry, so rage with good sense

parts.note: to rave is to rage wildly
nous is common sense

explanation.surface: Someone is starving, yet rants sensibly.
explanation.definitionFit: Ravenous means voraciously hungry.

clue.text: The new MO's cat's a lucky thing!

indicators.note: new suggests the letters are made into a fresh arrangement

parts.note: MO, medical officer, with the possessive S kept as a letter
taken as written

explanation.surface: The new medical officer's cat brings good fortune.
explanation.definitionFit: A mascot is a person, animal or object thought to bring good luck.

clue.text: A vile tale, unquestionably blunt

indicators.note: unquestionably, read as without doubt, is taken loosely as a sign to rearrange the letters

explanation.surface: A nasty story, told plainly without hesitation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blunt' is a verb: to blunt pain is to ease it. 'unquestionably' is an unusual anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To blunt suffering is to ease or lessen it.

clue.text: Edward and Albert have come back weighed down

indicators.note: coming back means the two names are read backwards as one run

parts.note: Ned is a short form of Edward
Al is a short form of Albert

explanation.surface: Two men return home heavily loaded.
explanation.definitionFit: Laden means loaded or burdened.

clue.text: The very best preparation for the skin

definitions.meaning: the pick of the bunch, the elite

explanation.surface: Advertising for a top skin product.
explanation.definitionFit: Cream means the elite, and also a thick lotion applied to the body.

clue.text: A little beast will be firm attending one

parts.note: Co is short for company, a firm
at means attending, present
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A small animal will stand firm beside someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A coati is a small raccoon-like mammal of the Americas.

clue.text: Deep depression in a woman — a dire condition

indicators.note: the answer is held in the clue's run of words, spanning them

explanation.surface: A woman in a terrible state is badly depressed.
explanation.definitionFit: A nadir is the lowest point, as of fortunes or spirits.

clue.text: A red seaweed and a green variety loaded onto transport

indicators.note: loaded onto means the rearranged letters sit after the vehicle

parts.note: a car is a form of transport

indicators.note: a variety of the letters means a different arrangement of them

explanation.surface: Seaweed and greens are piled onto a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: Carrageen is an edible red alga, also called Irish moss.

clue.text: Professional men with dormant skills

parts.note: read dormant as sending to sleep: doctors skilled at putting patients under

explanation.surface: Experts whose talents lie unused.
explanation.definitionFit: These medical specialists induce unconsciousness before surgery.
